camel_example: aliyun r-kvstore DescribeActiveOperationTask --region cn-hangzhou --TaskType rds_apsaradb_ha --Region all
description_en: Queries the details of the O\\&M tasks of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的运维任务详情
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore describe-active-operation-task --biz-region all --task-type rds_apsaradb_ha --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeActiveOperationTask

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the O&M task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html operation to query the most recent region list.

A value of all indicates all region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
待处理事件所属的地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html接口获取。
取值为all表示所有地域ID
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The type of the O\&M task. Valid values:

rds_apsaradb_ha: master-replica switchover
rds_apsaradb_transfer: instance migration
rds_apsaradb_upgrade: minor version update
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型，取值：

rds_apsaradb_ha：主备节点切换。
rds_apsaradb_transfer：实例迁移。
rds_apsaradb_upgrade：小版本升级
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the historical tasks. Default value: 0. Valid values:

0: returns the current task.
1: returns the historical tasks
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回历史任务，取值：
0：默认值，返回当前任务。
1：返回历史任务
parameters.name: is_history

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Specify a value greater than 10. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页可展示的最大记录数，取值需大于10，默认值为30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the O\&M task was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreatedTime.description_zh: 运维任务的创建时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

DbType.description_en: The database type of the instance. The return value is Redis

Deadline.description_en: The deadline before which the time to preform the O&M task can be modified. The time in UTC is displayed in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
Deadline.description_zh: 运维任务执行时间可调整范围的最晚期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

Id.description_en: The ID of the O&M task

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the O\&M task was modified. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 运维任务修改时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

PrepareInterval.description_en: The required preparation period between the task start time and the switchover time. The time is displayed in the HH:mm:ss format
PrepareInterval.description_zh: 运维任务开始时间到切换时间之间所需的准备时间，格式为HH:mm:ss

Region.description_en: The region ID of the instance

StartTime.description_en: The time when the O\&M task was preformed. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 运维任务执行的时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

Status.description_en:
The state of the O&M task. Valid values:

2: The task is waiting for users to specify a switchover time.
3: The task is waiting to be performed.
4: The task is being performed. If the task is in this state, the ModifyActiveOperationTask operation cannot be called to modify the scheduled switchover time.
5: The task is performed.
6: The task fails.
7: The task is canceled
Status.description_zh:
任务状态，返回值：
2：等待用户指定时间。
3：等待处理。
4：处理中。进入此状态后，不可调用ModifyActiveOperationTask修改计划切换时间。
5：成功。
6：失败。
7：已取消

SwitchTime.description_en: The time when the system performs the switchover operation. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
SwitchTime.description_zh: 系统发起的切换操作的时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

TaskType.description_en:
The type of the task. Valid values:

rds_apsaradb_ha: master-replica switchover
rds_apsaradb_transfer: instance migration
rds_apsaradb_upgrade: minor version update
all: all types
TaskType.description_zh:
任务类型，返回值：

rds_apsaradb_ha：主备节点切换。
rds_apsaradb_transfer：实例迁移。
rds_apsaradb_upgrade：小版本升级。
all：所有任务类型

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每页可展示的最大记录数

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of returned entries
